headline: Video game ownership bill introduced in Congress
summary: Congress introduces the 'Power To The Players Act'. Bill aims to guarantee consumers ownership of video games, not just a license. FTC would establish regulations if the bill passes.

headline: Lenovo's fast, comfy SteamOS handheld is hundreds off
summary: Lenovo's Legion Go S with SteamOS is now available at a significant discount. It offers superior specs compared to the Steam Deck OLED. Features include a bigger 120Hz screen, double RAM, and storage.

headline: J Mascis has nothing better to do
summary: Dinosaur Jr. frontman J Mascis is known for his stoic stage presence and unique guitar style. He maintains a reputation for giving quiet, non-committal answers in interviews. Mascis is described as a 'slacker guitar god'.

headline: Trump says Google kisses his ass
summary: Donald Trump claimed Google 'kisses his ass' during a rally in Kentucky. He boasted about his influence during his second term. Trump also mentioned renaming the Gulf of Mexico and Lake Ontario.

headline: Quentin Tarantino Confirms 10th and Final Film Script is Written
summary: Quentin Tarantino has confirmed he's written the script for his 10th and final film. He plans to take time to 'live' before starting production. This will be his last cinematic work.

headline: Russian Roulette Game Dev Cancels Steam Demo Over AI Copycat Fears
summary: Developer of the Russian roulette anime game 'Drunken Goddess Reflux' cancels its Steam demo. The decision was made due to concerns over potential AI copycats. The game was set to offer a public demo.

headline: Battlefield 6 Devs Address 'Secuty' Typo and Controversial Cosmetic
summary: Battlefield 6 developers responded to player criticism regarding new content. Players highlighted a 'Secuty' typo and a cosmetic featuring five pistols. These issues arose from controversial additions in Season 5.

headline: James Cameron Congratulates Marvel as Endgame Retakes Box Office Lead
summary: James Cameron congratulated Marvel after 'Avengers: Endgame' once again surpassed 'Avatar'. The films continue to trade the top spot for highest-grossing movie. Cameron shared his congratulations via social media.

headline: Paris Rocked by Riots and Looting After Protests
summary: Paris streets show signs of widespread riots and looting, including burnt cars and shattered glass. Protests escalated into violence across the city. Approximately 1,800 people were arrested nationwide.

headline: Green Party Leader Upholds 'Zionism is Racism' Motion
summary: Green Party leader Polanski confirmed he will not overturn the 'Zionism is racism' motion. He stated the controversial motion would stand until 2028. Polanski expressed a desire to amend the motion.

headline: Synthetic Drug Wave Deepens US Drug Crisis
summary: A new wave of homemade, synthetic drugs is sweeping across the United States. This surge is significantly deepening the country's ongoing drug crisis. BBC News investigates the impact on users, dealers, and recovery efforts.

headline: Police Hunt Synthetic Drugs in Chicago Jail
summary: Police are actively searching for synthetic drugs within Chicago jails. This effort is part of a broader battle against a deadly new drug epidemic in the US. The crisis impacts users, dealers, and prison workers nationwide.
